WEEKLY DENGUE UPDATE
Week 41 (05th – 11th October 2026)
National Dengue Control Unit, Ministry of H e a l t h
Year: 2026 Volume: 06 Issue: 41

DENGUE CASE REPORTING
During the 41st week, 1223 suspected dengue cases were
reported across all 26 districts/regions, compared to 1239
cases in the previous week, reflecting 1.3% decrease. The
Western Province accounted for 44.4% of total cases, with
the Colombo Municipal Council (CMC) contributing
5.1%, the rest of Colombo District 15.1%, Gampaha
District 18.6%, and Kalutara District 5.6%. Outside the
Western Province, notable case contributions were
reported from Kandy (15.2%), Galle (4.1%), Kalmunai
(3.7%), Matale (3.4%), Kegalle (3.2%), Ratnapura (3.2%),
Kurunegala (2.8%), Matara (2.7%), Hambantota (2.5%),
and Badulla (2.5%) (see Table 1) (compared to the previous
week, colour of %: red=increase, green=decrease, blue=no
change).
